Learn moreGame requires online multiplayer subscription to play on console.DETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionINTRODUCTION Chicken Invaders needs no introduction. Well, okay, if you insist. Chicken Invaders is the most successful chicken game of this millennium (not to mention the previous one). The game puts you at the forefront of a battle against invading intergalactic chickens, bent on revenge against the human race for our oppression of Earth chickens. And now, for the first time ever since its debut in 1999, the entire Chicken Invaders saga is available as a complete collection. COLLECTION CONTENTS - Episode 1: The Saga Begins Sometime in the near future, Earth is invaded by chickens from another galaxy, bent on revenge against the human race for oppressing earth chickens! Take the world's fate in your hands as you repel the poultry invasion. - Episode 2: The Next Wave Just when you thought it was safe to eat chicken again, the chickens have returned with an organized invasion to take over the entire solar system! Journey to each planet and fight your way through to save the world (again)! - Episode 3: Revenge of the Yolk In this episode, the chickens are constructing the Yolk-Star™ behind our sun, while you're stranded across the galaxy. You must return and foil their plans before you can witness the firepower of this fully armed and operational battle station! - Episode 4: Ultimate Omelette In this episode, the chickens have constructed a planet-sized egg cannon capable of coating the entire Earth with a delicious (but deadly) omelette layer! - Episode 5: Cluck of the Dark Side In this episode, the chickens have hatched a devious plan to block out sunlight and freeze Earth to death. It's up to you to travel around the galaxy in order to piece together an ancient artifact and (quite literally) save the day! NEW IN COLLECTION - Remastered graphics. Now presented in glorious 16:9 widescreen, supporting resolutions up to 4K. Each wave, cutscene, and menu has been individually reviewed and tweaked to account for the new aspect ratio and screen dimensions. - Improved weapons. The weapon roster has been reworked and rebalanced. Weapons are equally effective and more fun to use than ever before. - New spacecraft fleet. Fly one of four unique spacecraft, each one fully customizable. - Built-in seasonal content. Your progress (career stats, unlockables, mission progress) is now unified across all seasons. - New engine. More modern, more options, more visual effects, better customization of controls.Show morePublished byBETACOM S.A.Developed byBETACOM S.A.Play withXBOX OneXBOX Series X|SPCHandheldCapabilitiesXbox local co-op (2-2)Online co-op (2-8)Xbox local multiplayer (2-2)Online multiplayer (2-8)Xbox cross-platform multiplayer4K Ultra HDSingle playerShared/split screenXbox cross-platform co-opXbox Live Cross-Gen Multiplayer60 fps+Console Keyboard & MouseXbox achievementsXbox cloud savesXbox Play Anywhere XBOX consoles XBOX games XBOX Game Pass XBOX accessories XBOX News XBOX Support Feedback Community Standards Photosensitive Seizure Warning User Research at XBOX Microsoft account Microsoft Store Support Returns Orders tracking Store locations Rewards Games Designed for XBOX English (United States) Your Privacy Choices Opt-Out Icon Your Privacy Choices Consumer Health Privacy Sitemap Contact Microsoft Privacy & Cookies Manage cookies Terms of use Trademarks Third Party Notices Safety & eco About our ads

source.title: RACCOIN: Chaos Max Edition
source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 7Gambling ThemesGamesRACCOIN: Chaos Max EditionReleases 11/10/26VersionNintendo Switch 2EditionDigitalGambling ThemesLoadingRACCOIN is a roguelike deckbuilder where you combine special coins with powerful items to trigger wildly satisfying combos.RACCOIN: Chaos Max Edition blends the chaotic fun of classic arcade coin pushers with the element of roguelike deckbuilding. Combine special coins with powerful items to trigger satisfying synergies. It’s a nonstop dopamine rush packed into one unpredictable, coin dropping ride.SYNERGIZING COINS & CHAOSDiscover all kinds of special coins during your runs! Combine Seed Coins with Water Coins to grow a money tree right inside your machine. Drop a Cat Coin to hunt down every last Rat Coin and rack up extra tickets. Need more points? Use a Multiply Coin to boost your score across the board. Too slow? Launch a Nuclear Coin to trigger a massive explosion and blast every coin forward at once!CRAFT POWERFUL STRATEGIES WITH ITEMSStack multipliers, spawn coins with extra points, or simply shake the machine when you're running dry. Apply special plating to your favorite coins to enhance their effects and unlock even wilder combos.DIFFERENT CHARACTERS, DISTINCT PLAYSTYLESPlay as one of several unique characters, each with their own set of themed coins and playstyle. Take on the role of a greedy raccoon manager who excels at math-based combos, or a quirky biologist who specializes in animal-based coins. Every character offers a fresh and wildly different way to play.Software description provided by the publisher.About this itemGame file size (estimated)800 MBSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeNo. of playersSingle system (1)Nintendo Account family-group lendingSupportedNintendo Switch OnlineSave Data CloudPlay online, access classic NES™ and Super NES™ games, and more with a Nintendo Switch Online membership.
